description.value: A campground near Keremeos in the Okanagan-Thompson region; with no website data available, details on facilities, access, and setting are unknown.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Primary evidence is the Facebook page for Rustic Camping in Keremeos, which loaded successfully. The page confirms the OSM phone number and email, and provides a full postal address (4908 Hwy 3, Keremeos, BC V0X 1N1) absent from OSM tags. The Facebook intro explicitly states 'Water hookups only' and 'No hookups for power or septic,' which are the strongest amenity signals available; all other amenities go unmentioned.
concerns: No dedicated website — only a Facebook page. Web presence is limited.

Facebook displays 'Always open' but the page intro clearly states seasonal operation (May to mid October, weather permitting); the 'Always open' label is a Facebook default and should not be taken as year-round availability.
OSM tags contain no street address; address sourced from Facebook page only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating seasonal campground on Hwy 3 in Keremeos with recent social media activity and confirmed contact details. A useful stop for touring cyclists on this corridor.
